links.outcome: Clinical appropriateness of LLM assessments and management plans for Parkinson's vignettes
links.effect: Appropriate assessments 80.0% (Gemini) vs 86.7% (OpenEvidence); management plans 48.9% vs 57.8%; severe errors in plans 26.7% in both.
links.quote: Gemini 1.5 Pro and OpenEvidence showed high rates of clinically appropriate assessments (80.0% vs. 86.7%) but lower performance in management plans (48.9% vs. 57.8%).

links.outcome: Comparison of medically specialized LLM versus general-purpose LLM on appropriateness
links.effect: OpenEvidence vs Gemini: assessments 86.7% vs 80.0%, plans 57.8% vs 48.9%, both appropriate 55.6% vs 46.7%; no differences statistically significant.
links.quote: The medically specialized LLM demonstrated several qualitative advantages but no statistically significant performance benefit over the general-purpose model.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic assessment and management plan quality of two LLMs (Gemini 1.5 Pro and OpenEvidence) using 45 clinical vignettes in Parkinson's disease, rated by clinician experts, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
